Name: Login with valid credentials
Test Script (Steps) - Step: Navigate to login page; Enter valid username; Enter valid password; Click Login button
Test Script (Steps) - Expected Result: Login page displays; Username accepted; Password masked; Redirected to dashboard

Name: Login with invalid password
Test Script (Steps) - Step: Navigate to login page; Enter valid username; Enter incorrect password; Click Login button
Test Script (Steps) - Expected Result: Login page displays; Username accepted; Password masked; Error message: Invalid credentials

Name: Password reset request
Test Script (Steps) - Step: Navigate to login page; Click Forgot Password link; Enter registered email; Click Submit
Test Script (Steps) - Expected Result: Login page displays; Forgot password form opens; Email accepted; Success message: Reset email sent

Name: Add item to cart
Test Script (Steps) - Step: Navigate to product catalog; Select a product; Click Add to Cart button; View cart
Test Script (Steps) - Expected Result: Product catalog displays; Product detail shows; Confirmation toast appears; Cart shows 1 item

Name: Checkout with credit card
Test Script (Steps) - Step: Navigate to cart; Click Proceed to Checkout; Enter shipping address; Enter credit card details; Click Place Order
Test Script (Steps) - Expected Result: Cart shows items; Checkout form displays; Address validated; Payment accepted; Order confirmation displays

Name: Search for product
Test Script (Steps) - Step: Navigate to homepage; Enter product name in search box; Press Enter or click Search
Test Script (Steps) - Expected Result: Homepage loads; Search suggestions appear; Results show matching products

Name: Filter search results
Test Script (Steps) - Step: Perform a product search; Apply price range filter; Apply category filter
Test Script (Steps) - Expected Result: Results displayed; Results filtered by price; Results filtered by category

Name: User profile update
Test Script (Steps) - Step: Navigate to profile settings; Update display name; Update email address; Click Save Changes
Test Script (Steps) - Expected Result: Profile page loads; Name field updated; Email validation passes; Success message displays
